notes.title: Performance update
notes.notes:
Three quick fixes:
[list]
[*] Locked framerate to 60, instead of, "Whatever your machine can handle."
[*] Increased the resolution of some of the planetary UI elements so that they aren't pixelated, specifically in the first mission.
[*] Created a 700ms buffer between when a dialogue screen closes and when you can launch a probe, to prevent accidental lanches.
[/list]

notes.title: Expedition intro text update.
notes.notes: Pat of the dialog that introduces players to Expedition Mode was too long and truncating, so we've spit that into different frames.
